nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Page-chunk owner for frozen work item 1. It receives that item's complete literal `{course_id,course_code,course_name,total_count,page_start,page_end}`. In its first tool-call response it issues the one-to-four independent `canvas_get_course_grades(course_id=<literal ID>, page=<each integer page_start..page_end>, per_page=100, type=["StudentEnrollment"])` calls natively in parallel. It verifies the returned pages equal that exact interval and every page reports the frozen `pagination.total_count`. From `enrollment.grades.current_score`, ignore nulls and return only `{course_id,course_code,course_name,total_count,page_start,page_end,pages_observed,returned_rows,graded_count,score_sum,score_min,score_max,duplicate_pages,missing_pages}`. Do not return enrollment IDs, score lists, or raw rows, and do not modify Canvas.

explore 1 (enterprise-data-analyst 1): Page-chunk owner for frozen work item 2 — same literal recipe, only that item's identity substituted.

   K. explore K-1 (enterprise-data-analyst K-1): Page-chunk owner for frozen work item K — same literal recipe, only that item's identity substituted. If K>128, keep this numbering across the minimum number of consecutive waves of at most 128.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): One Coder is the sole writer of Canvas_Grade_Summary.xlsx in the dynamically resolved task workspace. Create exactly Grade Summary and Summary with the exact headers, canonical rows and literal values; read both populated ranges back.

coder 1 (external-workflow-operator 0): One Coder is the sole owner of the Google spreadsheet titled Grade Summary Report. Create the spreadsheet once, write only the header plus the three canonical summary rows to the exact range A1:B4, and read A1:B4 back. Do not add diagnostic cells or any extra data range.
